accessibility: Skip to content link becomes visible on focus and targets the main landmark.
Global focus-visible outline is 2px primary with 3px offset; navigation uses pale blue.
Navigation announces the active route with aria-current=page.
Button loading sets aria-busy and disables repeat activation; disabled buttons use opacity .5.
Text fields retain associated labels; decorative navigation and brand icons are aria-hidden.
Reduced-motion rules suppress recurring animation and shorten transitions.
Graph type uses border patterns as well as semantic color.
ToolNavigation and editing operation controls announce their selected state with aria-pressed; these are tool switches rather than sequential progress indicators.
Reasoning results use aria-live=polite, inline errors use role=alert, and training messages use role=status.
ProviderConnection retains associated field labels and a status region for live catalog updates, empty states and discovery errors; model entry remains usable when discovery is unavailable.

validation.status: Backend 38 tests and frontend 21 tests passed. Production build passed. Desktop browser checks at 1440px and 1280px passed. Impeccable finish review disposition: ship after confirming reasoning tool continuity.
validation.notCanonized: Legacy step-related CSS remains in the source, but numbered progression is not rendered by StepSection and is not system guidance. Semantic success/error styling and graph relation colors are retained for their data roles; they are not additional brand accents.
validation.tonalRamps: No synthetic ramps recorded; source-truth colors only.

testEvidence.provenance: Implementation agent test runs and desktop browser checks; finish reviewer confirmed the reported tool-continuity fix from source and capture.

limitations: Mobile acceptance deferred by the user.
External LLM discovery and generation use deterministic fixtures; paid provider calls were not run.

branding.mark: DICE cube paths reused as inline SVG with currentColor; no generated imagery.
branding.browserIcon: src/app/icon.svg reuses the original DICE cube; the default favicon.ico was removed.

Edit.navigation: Compact wrapping editing-tool buttons and an Add/Remove operation switch.
Edit.pattern: Selected ontology context, active axiom form and ontology save/download controls.

Generate.pattern: Independent configuration panels with a separate status and result column.

controls: Searchable live model catalog with custom model IDs
providerConnection.layout: Provider preset and protocol share a two-column row with a 16px gap. Connection groups use 20px spacing. The model catalog is separated by a mineral border and 20px top padding.
providerConnection.typography: 14px control labels and inputs; 12px secondary explanations and status; API base URL uses Geist Mono.
providerConnection.catalogBehavior: Debounced 600ms reload on connection changes; refresh on window focus and every five minutes while visible; explicit manual refresh. Prior requests are cancelled when the connection changes.
providerConnection.customModelBehavior: Custom model IDs remain available when model discovery fails or returns no entries.
providerConnection.pricingRule: Show the zero token price filter only when explicit provider pricing reports zero input and output token prices and an absent or zero request price. Free-tier and account-credit offers are separate provider annotations linked to official terms, not inferred per-model pricing.
stateRules: Show fetching state and catalog update time.
Reset model choice on credential or connection edits; reset credentials when endpoint or protocol changes.
Use a labeled password field with autocomplete disabled for the optional API key.
Expose discovery errors and empty catalog guidance through a status region.
Non-JSON catalog responses show recovery guidance and preserve manual model entry.
providerConnection.defaultProvider: OpenRouter; live catalog is available without a key, generation requires provider credentials.

narrative.overview: OntoSource supports ontology engineering for researchers through persistent navigation and compact, legible work areas. The DICE cube and its blue identity anchor navy navigation, pale blue selection, cool mineral backgrounds and white working surfaces. Edit, Generate and Predict expose independent dashboard tools, with ontology context and results visible beside the active working area.
keyCharacteristics: DICE cube branding and blue identity
Compact ontology sidebar and expanded runtime graph
Independent dashboard tools without numbered progression
Locally hosted Geist interface text and Geist Mono identifiers

rules.name: DICE Blue
rules.body: Derive the interface palette from the DICE logo blue. Use action blue for primary controls, navy for the persistent rail and pale blue for its selected destination; graph colors continue to encode ontology semantics.

rules.name: Working Hierarchy
rules.body: Use the shared page heading, 16px tool section titles and compact 14px body text; reserve mono for technical identifiers, expressions and generated syntax.

rules.name: Flat Work Surfaces
rules.body: Separate panels with white surfaces and mineral borders; graph controls carry the small elevation shadow.

dos: Do reuse the DICE cube geometry from Logo and the root logo asset.
Do reuse PageHeader, unnumbered StepSection, ToolNavigation, Button, Card and Badge for consistent hierarchy and states.
Do present Edit, Generate and Predict as independently selectable dashboard tools with selected ontology context.
Do preserve labeled controls, visible focus, loading states and live results.
Do retain the runtime graph, semantic node border patterns and the Family ontology demo.
Do keep provider offer terms separate from explicit model pricing, and retain custom endpoint and model ID entry when live discovery is unavailable.
donts: Do not reintroduce numbered progression to the dashboard tools.
Do not replace the DICE cube with a generic network icon or generated brand image.
Do not replace ontology data with decorative image assets.
Do not treat desktop source inspection as mobile acceptance or final verification.
